questions.q: What did Mr. Briggs want Jerry to do?
choices: Take Mrs. Briggs to church every Sunday morning
Sell him his horse Jack
Drive him to the train every day
Work for him as a coachman

His cab was broken
His horses were sick
Cabs were not allowed in church streets

The police took it away
He wanted to drive only at night

He got a bigger cab

questions.evidence: I have laid by more money in the savings bank than ever I did before

choices: The Briggses were good customers he might lose
Mr. Briggs was a policeman
Mr. Briggs owned Jerry's house

questions.evidence: if I don't oblige her in this matter it is very likely we shall lose them altogether

Sell the cab and find other work
